  "recovered_c": "uint64_t custom_hash(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  if ((len < 24) || (out_cap < 8)) {\n    return 0xffffffffffffffff;\n  }\n  uint32_t state1 = *in;\n  uint32_t state2 = in[1];\n  int i = 0;\n  do {\n    uint32_t temp = len + 1;\n    i = i - 0x61c88647;\n    if ((((uint)len * (int)temp & 1) != 0) || (DAT_00104010 != 0)) {\n      state1 = ((uint)(len << 7) ^ state1) * 0x2d6b + DAT_00104008;\n      state1 = state1 >> 0xb ^ state1;\n    }\n    uint32_t temp1 = (uint)len | 1;\n    state1 = state1 + (state2 * 0x10 + in[2] ^ (state2 >> 5) + in[3] ^ i + state2);\n    len = temp;\n    if (((temp1 * temp1 & 7) != 1) || (DAT_00104008 != 0x3c71)) break;\n    uint32_t temp2 = state2 + (state1 * 0x10 + in[4] ^ (state1 >> 5) + in[5] ^ i + state1);\n    if (i == -0x3910c8e0) goto LAB_0010120c;\n  } while (i != -0x3910c8e0);\n  LAB_0010120c:\n  state2 = state2 + 0x51e3 ^ state2;\n  state2 = state2 + 0x1f9;\n  out[0] = (state2 >> 0x18) & 0xff;\n  out[1] = (state2 >> 0x10) & 0xff;\n  out[2] = (state2 >> 8) & 0xff;\n  out[3] = state2 & 0xff;\n  out[4] = (state1 >> 0x18) & 0xff;\n  out[5] = (state1 >> 0x10) & 0xff;\n  out[6] = (state1 >> 8) & 0xff;\n  out[7] = state1 & 0xff;\n  return 8;\n}"
